title: Manual blend: two-shot panorama stitching with trapezoid distortion, clone stamp, and advanced toning
summary: This instructional video demonstrates manual stitching of two overlapping wide-angle frames into a single wide panorama. The workflow centers on creating a trapezoid distortion to extend the scene, aligning two shots with a warp, and performing a meticulous manual blend with the clone stamp to hide seams. The presenter then enhances tonal range through diffusion and luminosity adjustments, uses an auto-HDR–like sequence to recover shadow detail, and finishes with color grading via split toning, selective color, and LAB-based dodging to preserve sunlit highlights. Throughout, non-destructive history-based edits and multiple clone-paint variants are used to refine the composition and minimize visible seams, culminating in a result that looks like a single, wide, distorted image rather than two combined frames.

sections.title: Initial exposure/contrast adjustments and flare assessment
sections.description: Introduces the idea that edge clarity affects only a portion of the image while contrast impacts the whole frame. The speaker adjusts highlights and exposure, notes flare, and discusses reducing clarity to mitigate it.

sections.title: Two-shot planning and flare-driven approach
sections.description: Discusses flare across frames and contemplates using a later shot to broaden the scene. Frames the intent to blend two shots to create a wider composition.

sections.title: Perspective warp and trapezoid distortion for alignment
sections.description: Describes turning one image into a trapezoid and aligning it with another so distortion continues across frames. Demonstrates alt-click alignment and using a hard-edge clone to blend along the seam.

sections.title: Manual blending workflow and historical edits
sections.description: Shows a step-by-step manual blend of two shots, emphasizing alignment, hard-edged cloning, and non-destructive history editing to refine the blend and project progression.

sections.title: Diffusion, luminosity, and auto-HDR-like toning
sections.description: Outlines applying diffusion to distant and bright areas and intensifying luminosity around the sun star. Describes a three-pass approach (shadow + clarity + noise reduction) to emulate HDR, followed by LAB-based dodging to brighten highlights without color distortion.

sections.title: Final polish: color grading, selective color, and save strategy
sections.description: Details warmth and brightness adjustments for the background, selective color adjustments on foliage, and final diffusion refinements. Covers LAB-based brightening of highlights, the use of sponge for light on foliage, and strategies for non-destructive editing and saving multiple states.
